batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b HV Patel

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b R Vinay Kumar

batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b AB Dinda

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b MN Samuels

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c R Sharma b AD Mathews

balls.text: third man is up and he squeezes that over Zaheer at short third, a thick outside edge but he went hard at that one, cleared Zaheer and it fetched him a boundary
Kohli takes an easy one this time, short outside off, tried to swat it over long-off but mistimed it completely, a comfortable catch to Kohli

picks the slower one this time, lands on a length and it's driven through extra cover, wide of long-off for a couple of runs, in the end, Mathews has to run over de Villiers, a wide throw from Kohli there
short one outside off, was the slow legcutter, was within the marking line, not called a wide, called one for the over
another slower one and he's cut it this time, straight to point, just the single
slower one bowled short, tried to cut that through point, missed, not called a wide
that's well connected, short on the off and he makes room to smash that hard over the long-on boundary, a swat that, and was well struck
low full toss, makes room and places that through extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
angling in, gets forward and gets a thick inside edge while trying to defend, a single through square leg
Run-out, Samuels is livid with himself, slower one again, they tried to sneak another bye but AB hit his target this time, a direct hit at the striker's end and Samuels was caught well short
The umpire takes it on the foot, Samuels drills it back down the pitch and catches the umpire on the ankle, it ricochets towards long-off, just the single
slower one, cuts away to go past the outside edge, they sneak a bye

bowled that full outside off, tried to dig it out, there was a deviation but it may have been a bump ball, not sure. The umpire said no initially but then decided to refer it to the third umpire to confirm. Low full toss and it came off the edge and landed on the ground before bumping towards the keeper, not out

slower one bowled short and they try to sneak a bye, tried to whack that over point, missed, Samuels it appeared called for a single, de Villiers under-armed it back to Vinay and he took off the bails, Smith was given run-out immediately, the umpire didn't refer it, we need a replay to confirm that once again for our own purposes. The decision's already been made on the field. And that replay hasn't come yet.
slower one outside off, shovelled it through midwicket for a single
didn't get hold of that one, slower one again and he got a top-edge as he tried to swat that over the bowler's head, landed short of the long-off fielder
full toss and it's been thrashed, but straight to the fielder, thwacked it to deep extra cover
slower one and it's been sent over long-on, picked the change in pace and lofted it high and handsome into the stands
shortish, dropped that in front of cover for one more
that's been crashed, came down the track, Vettori fired it hard on a length and Samuels whipped it hard over the midwicket fielder
comes down the track and pushes that straight to the bowler
in the blockhole outside off, or rather he converts it into a yorker by coming down the track, dug out wide of Zaheer at extra cover, there's a misfield and they're back for the second
pushed down towards point for a quick single
that's been dispatched, tossed up, lands full and he slog-sweeps it miles into the stands behind deep midwicket, powerful hit
excellent over, trying to get it into the blockhole again, driven wide of deep extra cover for a couple more runs
there is a fine leg in place and he just gets the single, moved well across and flicked it well, but straight to fine leg
low full toss, almost a yorker, played out towards long-off for a single, coming round the wicket is Zak
bowled that short outside off, cracked straight to extra cover
in the blockhole outside off, dug out towards extra cover for a single
well fielded by Appanna at point, short and that was played wide of him, fived full length to his left to keep them to one
short ball, comes down the track and swats that to long-off for a single
the slower offcutter, Smith wanted to send that over long-on but again, didn't pick the slower one, missed again
slower one bowled full on leg stump, turned through square leg for one more
angled in towards middle and leg, would have gone down, tried to work it into the leg side, struck high on the pads
slower one bowled short outside off, Smith was too early into the cut, missed
angling in towards middle, pushed gently by Smith into the leg side through midwicket and they're able to steal the second, the fielder had a fair distance to cover in the deep
Samuels sends that into the stands, a bit of flight, he charges down and smashes that hard over long-off for a big one
presses that one away to give Samuels the strike
drives that down the ground for a single
good running, pushed through the leg side and the fielder in the deep takes a while to get to it, they snap a second
worked that one into the leg side for a single
Uthappa goes, sliced that one straight towards point, was looking good, Vettori finished his over on a successful note, some width there and he'll feel he played a lazy shot
knocks a single as it angled in

comes down the track to work it into the leg side, missed and AB moved way too much to his left there and couldn't collect it as it ricocheted off the pads, not quite a missed stumping, he didn't have much of a chance
angling in towards middle, turned it behind square for a single
thrashed, picked the slower one early, landed in the slot outside off stump and that was punished, slammed through extra cover
Ganguly has to go, Mayank Agarwal takes another good catch, was placed at deep point, short and wide and Ganguly cut it straight to him in the deep

dropped, would have been an outstanding catch, full marks for the effort, short ball and that was crashed towards long-off, dived full length to his left but it dropped out of his hand the moment he made contact with the ground, Appanna was the man there
banged it short outside off, upper-cut that towards third man, got to him on the bounce
Missed run-out, chopped that towards point, Ganguly had given up on the single and Dilshan didn't aim accurately, he was out by a mile had that hit
Mid-off is inside the circle, was a short ball bowled slow, moved away and swatted it over mid-off's head for a boundary
makes a bit of room there and it's bowled almost in the blockhole, Ganguly digs it out but cannot beat midwicket
pitched up on the off, drives it down to long-off for a single, raises the 100 for Pune
bowls that short on leg stump, turns it wide of square leg for one more
quicker through the air, shortish, comes down the track and knocks it down into the leg side for a single
fires it quick outside off, lofts it over extra cover, wide of long-off, for a couple of runs, a chip
shortish on the off, waits for it to turn away and slaps it to extra cover, can't beat the fielder there
tries to paddle that fine this time, Dilshan appeals in vain, came off the pad, a single towards short fine
two fours in a row off the same shot, too straight from Dilshan and Uthappa is just helping them past short third, also brings up his half-century, this is his best performance with the bat for Pune
beats Zaheer this time, smartly done, placed it just wide of that fielder this time, and had some power in it as well, the reverse-sweep again
round the wicket, bowled quick on middle, reverse-swept well but straight to short third man where Zaheer's placed
ooh, short on middle, pulled hard past Kohli who dives to his left at midwicket, just beat him, two more into the deep
fires it short on middle, pushed off the back foot through midwicket for a single, they thought of a second but decided against it eventually
short of a good length, is guided down to third man for a single
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and works it wide of midwicket for a single
smartly done, was the legcutter, Uthappa waited for that one and opened the face at just the right time to guide it past the diving de Villiers for a boundary
banged in short outside off, just went past the glove, tried to open the face there, was surprised by the extra bounce there
pitched up, he senses a chance, makes room and carts that one over extra cover for a boundary, came off the meat
short of a good length, drops it down into the off side
pinches a single to remain on strike
tossed up and he takes full toll, moves out of his crease and simultaneously gives himself some room before hammering it over the deep midwicket boundary
called a wide, full outside leg and he tries to paddle that as well, AB appeals again after collecting well

appeal for a catch, angling towards the leg stump, tried to paddle it fine, popped up off the pads and appeared to hit the glove, though anothe replay would really help, before popping up towards de Villiers, not given, Difficult to tell
flighted, lands full, pushes it down the ground to long-off
tossed up outside off, drives it hard towards deep extra cover
shortish outside off, Ganguly gets on the back foot and punches that through extra cover for a single

that's miles in the air, and it's well judged in the deep, short on the off and he attempted to pull that into the stands behind deep square leg, was a bit of a top edge in the end, took forever to come down and Mayank Agarwal, placed in the deep, never took his eyes off it
slower one bowled short outside off, plays it down to third man for a single
short of a good length outside off, another single to the third man fielder
angling in towards middle, tried to work it square, struck high on the pads, they steal a leg-bye
short of a length outside off, opens the face for another single to third man
short of a good length outside off, runs that one down to third man for a single
full toss, short fine leg is up, comes down the track and flicks that behind square, easy pickings, four more
pitched up on the off, driven straight towards extra cover
pushed in the direction of long-off for a single
comes down the track and smacks that hard wide of the diving mid-on, wasn't quite to the pitch but he swung it hard and beat the fielder
gets forward and guides that one towards short third man, waits for it to turn away
fires that full on leg stump, driven down to long-on for a single
just chipped that one over the bowler's head for a single to long-on
slower one, the offcutter again, Ryder was too early into the pull there, was short, missed
slower one bowled short outside off, pushed towards point
edged and four, third man is inside the circle, Patel bowled another slower one, tried to crack that over the covers but got a thick outside edge, over short-third man and well wide of slip
short of a good length outside off, was the slower one bowled short, the offcutter, tried to open the face there, missed
and he is smashed first up, doles out a length ball on the off, in the slot for Ryder who sends it hard over the bowler's head, lands on the ropes, maximum
short of a good length on the off, punched towards cover from the crease, no single on offer there
Zaheer fields that at short fine, Ryder gets across and flicks it behind square, just the single
shortish outside off, opens the face at the right time to guide it down to a fine third man for a single
down the leg side, moved across to glance it fine, didn't get a bat to it, a wide though
short and wide and it's slashed hard, there is a slip in place but it evaded him by a distance, flew off the outside edge to the third-man boundary
angling in towards middle, gets front and across and pushes it back down the pitch
short of a good length outside off, chopped that one towards point, can't get it past him
slower one, tries to open the face but can't make contact
clears the in-field, lands on a good length, he moves away and crashes that over the mid-off fielder for four more
short of a good length, guides that one down to third man for a single
dropped that short on leg stump, tried to help it down to the fine-leg boundary, caught the glove, only managed a single in the end
smacked back and Zaheer's outstretched hand missed that one, crashed it hard straight back past the bowler, uppish but that was slapped hard
short of a good length outside off, swung away over square leg into the deep for a couple of runs
angling in from round the wicket, turns it wide of mid-on for one more
punched away for an easy single
short and wide, gets on the back foot and cuts that hard through point this time, four more, width and he cashed in
slog-sweep, lands on a good length, gets forward and thrashes that over the deep square leg boundary, powerfully hit
shortish outside off, gets on the back foot and cracks it to point
shortish outside off, gets on the back foot and punches that to long-off
on a length, pushes that one wide of mid-off for a single
goodish length, guides that one behind point for a single
short of a good length outside off, pushed off the back foot to point
angling in towards middle and leg, pushes that one towards mid-on for a single
short of a good length, drops it in front of point and picks a quick single
beaten this time, short of a good length outside off, gets it to nip away and Uthappa is beaten by the away movement as he pokes at that one
a wide down the leg side, way down, some swing there, AB does well diving full length to his left to stop that

Six, Bangalore have won it! And it's begun to pour at the Chinnaswamy Stadium! They're celebrating in the rain, length ball again from Nehra as he was aiming for the yorker, was in the slot for Tiwary and hammered it flat over the long-on boundary for a maximum
low full toss, comes down the track and hits it to midwicket, couldn't get it past, just the single, 3 needed off the final ball
Six more, Nehra's shell-shocked, AB you beauty! Pitched on a length, he moved across and scooped it over the fine leg boundary, the yorker gone bad and he pays with a six
this game is very much alive, low full toss and AB connects superbly, the bottom hand came off when he made contact, but that was a meaty strike, cleared long-off, 10 needed off 3
a boundary, AB manages it somehow, moved well across to scoop it past short fine, was short of a good length, tried to pull it while on a bent knee, went off the arm past Uthappa for a boundary
just a single, good stuff from Pune, pitched up outside off and it's driven to extra cover for just a single
in the blockhole outside off, digs it out to long-off, excellent over by Dinda given the context of this game
pitched up but there's Steven Smith at long-off and he keeps them to just a single
low full toss, slices it over cover into the deep, Rahul runs across and keeps them to a single
a couple of runs this time, low full toss, steered wide of deep point for a couple of runs, not a great throw from the deep either
mistimes a drive, full and wide and he can only play it to extra cover, Dinda's holding his hip, is in a bit of pain
pitched up outside off, makes room and slices it to deep cover, just the single
low full toss, comes down the track and hits it to Ganguly at extra cover, just the single
pitched up again, slices it towards deep point, Uthappa failed to collect it cleanly, wasn't a great throw and they sensed a chance, picked up the second as well
connects well, Bangalore are fighting back, lands on a length on middle and he dispatches it over deep midwicket, good clean strike, 150 up
pitched up, makes room and strikes that wide of long-off, just the single, wanted the second but Smith handled it well in the deep
reverse-swept for six, the keeper came up to the stumps, third man was inside the circle, on a length outside off and he picks it clean over the third-man boundary, he's done it before
the stumps at the non-striker's end have been dismantled, drilled down the pitch, no run in the end, the pressure grows
comes down the track and pulls it on the bounce to deep square leg for a single
misfield at extra cover and a boundary has been conceded, short outside off and de Villiers swatted it hard, Ganguly was the culprit
short and wide and it's been cut away towards deep point for a single
a good slower delivery, Tiwary didn't pick it, was the legcutter and he played it too early
poor ball, a full toss down the leg side and Tiwary helps it down to the fine-leg boundary
shortish on the off, goes for the pull, gets a thick inside edge, just the single

slower one bowled short outside off, tapped it in front of point, wants the single, is sent back, the fielder fails to score a direct hit and concedes an overthrow. After all the chaos, a time out is called for
pitched on a length outside off, driven straight to extra cover
cleaned him up! The perfect yorker from Nehra, was in the blockhole on leg stump, excellent reply from the bowler, made way to strike it through the leg side, missed and timber!

just cleared long-off, had just about enough on it, was bowled short on the off and he slapped it over the ropes, just about, didn't middle it but he'll take it, raises the 50 stand of which Tiwary has scored 9
full toss, called a no-ball, was above the waist and Tiwary mistimed the pull, a single plus one
full toss, swung away to deep square leg, just the single there
low full toss on the off, strikes that straight to long-off
fullish on leg stump, flicked into the deep wide of long-on to keep the strike
in the blockhole outside off, digs it out towards long-off for a single
slower one, he picks it, lands full and he drills that straight to long-off, just the single
slower one bowled short on the off, knocked away into the off side for a single
pitched up, driven hard wide of long-off, Ryder cuts it off, just the single
short of a length outside off, cut straight to point, Samuels prevents the single
goodish length, drops that towards point to take a single, decent work from Mathews here
slower one bowled short outside off, stabs it towards long-off for a single
ooh, kept that one tight, short of a good length on middle, pushed it back to the bowler
short of a good length, pushed towards cover for a single
comes down the track and slices that over point for a couple of runs
slower one, tries to open the face, misses
Five in a row, Rahul's being punished, flighted this time, landed on a length on middle and leg and it was swung into the crowd behind deep square leg
another one, four in a row, that's into the top tier, Rahul came round the wicket and bowled it flat but Gayle was determined, sent it a fair distance behind long-on
three in a row, in the slot on the off stump and that's been drilled, over the bowler's head for the flattest of sixes
this is bigger, fires it full on the pads, takes it off a length and thrashes it over the deep midwicket boundary, Gayle's launched the surge here, brings up his half century
long hop, short outside off and Gayle powers it over the long-off boundary, was there to hit and he sent it miles
worked away into the leg side for a single
struck well off the meat, drives that through the line and it beats long-off to the fence when it seemed there was only a single on offer

The pressure grows on Bangalore, this time with the wicket of Kohli, swung at that one across the line, there was some away movement there, got the leading edge and Rahul Sharma running in from deep point, with the fielder at cover also running back, judged it well
ooh, length ball and Gayle was aiming at deep midwicket, got an inside edge and it struck Uthappa on the thigh, wasn't too far from the stumps either, called a bye though
low full toss on middle, whipped to deep midwicket for a single
short of a good length on the off, punched towards long-off for a single
tight line, short of a good length, pushed it down to long-off for a single
shortish on the off, punched uppishly to long-off for a single
full on leg stump, tried to work it square, struck on the pads, they take a single
short ball on the off, pulled away straight to deep midwicket for one more
short of a good length on middle, pushed it towards extra cover for a single
short on middle and leg, pulled but straight to short fine leg
short on middle, pulled away towards deep midwicket for a single
short of a good length on middle, jabs that one back towards the bowler
slower one bowled short outside off, pushes that wide of cover for a single
slower one bowled short on middle, pulled away towards deep midwicket for a single
connects superbly, full toss, comes down the track and drills it down the ground for a boundary
good length on the off, drives it towards long-off for a single
slower one bowled full outside off, steered that straight towards point
bowled that short outside off, Kohli pushed it gently wide of mid-off for a single to keep strike, time for a time out
slower one bowled short outside off, chopped it wide of cover for a single
gets front and across and drives that through midwicket into the deep for a single
short of a good length, comes down the track and drives it on the up towards deep cover, wide of him in fact for a couple of runs
slower one bowled short this time, mistimes a pull towards long-on for one more
dropped that short on middle, bowled at 134kmph, Gayle went for the pull but didn't connect
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and works it straight to midwicket
full toss on middle, pushed down the ground to long-off for a single
shortish outside off, cracked towards deep point for a single
gets on the back foot this time and turns it towards square leg
shortish on the off, punched towards long-off for a single
in the blockhole on middle and off, is played back towards the bowler
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot, gets an inside edge onto the shoe
picked the gap well, short ball and he pulled it between fine leg and deep square leg, just helped it, easy pickings
gets on the back foot to play it into the leg side, Kohli wants the single, Gayle doesn't and sends him back
good bounce again, struck Kohli high on the pads as it jumped off short of a good length
good bounce for Bhuvneshwar, Gayle tapped it wide of point for a single
short of a good length on the off, rocks back and defends it towards point
Samuels strikes, was struck well but Manhas was perfectly placed at deep square leg, was at the edge of the ropes and kept his cool as that was pulled straight to him, made no mistake
pitched up on leg stump, drives that straight towards midwicket
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it to extra cover
swings that through square leg for a single
shortish on the off, tries to pull him into the leg side but that came on slower than he expected, struck on the thigh
turns in from outside off, defended into the off side
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and plays it into the leg side
short of a length outside off, cut away but straight to point
bad bounce for the fielder at cover, short and wide and Gayle thrashed it straight towards cover, got a bad bounce did Mathews and it went over his head as he bent low to collect that
slower one bowled short outside off, comes down the track to hammer it over mid-on, didn't pick the change in pace there, missed
short of a good length outside off, chops that one down to point
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and taps it towards midwicket
in the slot for Gayle, was pitched up, came down the track and lofted it just over the long-off boundary, just cleared the ropes, the chase is on
this one's disappeared, it's a crowd killer, danced down the track, picked it from a length and swung it hard over the deep midwicket boundary, punished
short ball outside off and Gayle was in control of that one, moved away and cut that smartly over point for a boundary, one bounce four
short on middle, it's pulled away uppishly towards deep square leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, tried to run that to third man, couldn't connect as he opened the face
thick outside edge, angling in towards middle, pitched on a good length, flew off the outside edge down to third man for a single
lovely hit, pitched on a length and Agarwal struck that superbly through the line, lofting it clean over the bowler's head and all the way into the crowd, beautifully hit
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and defends it to cover
short and wide and he goes for the upper-cut, chased it did Agarwal, a no-ball for height this time, well over his head
a fast full toss on middle, it's tapped into the off side for a single, Gayle was caught by surprise there
banged it short outside leg stump, too wide and it's called one by the umpire, a single as well to go with it as Uthappa can't collect it cleanly
The Dilscoop goes bad, tried to play that over the keeper and offered a dolly to the keeper, may have struck the helmet on the way, Pune have struck early
banged in short outside off, pulled that towards deep midwicket for a single
banged in short on middle and off, ducks under it well but it's been called a wide for height, Sourav is not happy with the decision and has a word with the umpire
pitched on a length, it's pushed to mid-off on the up for a single, almost a collision between the bowler and Dilshan
short and it's straight to point, Gayle moved away and cut that well but can't beat the in-field, a good couple of overs from Pune

edged and short of slip, angled in towards middle and nipped away, gets on the back foot to defend, gets a thick outside edge, goes off the thigh on the way to the slip fielder, got to Ryder on the bounce
angling in towards middle and off, defended into the off side
Gayle dances down the track to smash that over deep midwicket, misses as it moves away
banged in short on middle, Gayle ducks under that one, bowled at 127.9kph
provides him with some width, tries to drive it through the covers, gets a thick inside edge, just the single
pitched on a length outside off and he tries to flay that through the covers, gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single
banged in short outside off, goes for the pull and he misses again, a touch too quick, bowled at 141 kph
short of a good length on the off, nips back in a hint, he had shaped himself up for a cut but was too close to play the shot in the end, beaten
goodish length on middle, gets on the back foot and pushes it past the bowler for a single
short outside off, stands tall in the crease and thrashes that towards point, Smith fields well but a small fumble allows them a single
Dilshan goes for the pull and misses, bowled it short outside off and he tried to smack it through midwicket, didn't make contact
